original_question: Johnny were $20 ana akwu ya wee tinye $10 ọzọ na ya. O tinyeziri nchikota ego a, nke ji okpukpu atọ wee bawanye n'otu afọ. Ego ole ka o nwere mgbe otu afọ gachara?.

question_solution: answer = (num_digit_1 + num_digit_2) * f1   # f1 is the numeric value of num_text_1
